errors.evidence: The chart legend identifies the two systems as "Cluster" and "Raw". "FinNA" is one of the categories on the horizontal axis, not a model system shown in the legend.
The description of the horizontal axis omits the first category, "FinFE".
The labels on the horizontal axis are not in alphabetical order (e.g., FinFE, FinQA, FinNA...).
The vertical axis does not have a visible label. The description invents the label "值" (value).
The vertical axis has a linear scale, not a logarithmic scale or both.
The major tick marks on the vertical axis are at intervals of 20 (0, 20, 40, 60, 80), not 10.
The visible range of the y-axis is from 0 to over 80. The data values extend from approximately 35 to 95, which is not captured by the stated range of 30 to 70.
